method: Blind re-read of the Digi-Key product page for each task line (digikey.com, USD, 'All prices are in USD'), one page at a time, 20 s pause before every read. Rows are the visible price table's UNIT prices, every packing, qty >= 100 only. 'Cut Tape (CT) & Digi-Reel' is recorded as 'cut tape'; 'Tape & Reel (TR)' as 'reel'. grade / qualification are the product-attribute fields as printed (null = the page shows no such field; a 'Features' / 'Ratings' mention is put in notes).

readLog: 32 Digi-Key page reads, 0 searches, 0 refusals (no 403 / 429 / 503). 9 detail URLs and 23 keyword URLs; every keyword URL landed directly on the single product page for the exact code, so no second read was needed. Pages were read through a fetch-and-extract tool that returns the visible page content as text; hidden data (JSON-LD, script variables) was excluded by instruction. Caveat for whoever compares: on 14 pages the cut-tape table stops at 100 / 250 / 500 with no 1,000 row although the reel is larger than 1,000 - recorded as returned, not filled in. On 4 pages (L9026-YO-TR, TSC2020IYST, A7987TR, TSV912IYST - all STMicroelectronics) a reel price is dearer than the largest cut-tape break, as printed. One packing outside the rules' five values occurs: 'strip' (MAX25410AGTE/V+).
